about: Golden numbers (v51.25). golden: verified true by the user against the save's sheet (export of 30 Sep 2026) on 18 Oct 2026; a change fails npm run check. pinned: not in the sheet; a change is reported for a look but doesn't fail. Values are read from the rendered page (render.js snapshots, desktop width): the page's text is split into its text pieces, golden.js finds the anchor (labels, in order) and compares the pieces after it with expect (null = not checked). Never edit this file without the design chat and the user.
